description: Set the contents of an inventory slot in creative mode. Pass `item` (name or id) with optional `count`/`nbt` to place a stack, or omit `item` (or set it null) to empty the slot. Requires the bot to be in creative gamemode.

anyOf.description: Item name (e.g. "diamond_pickaxe") or numeric item id

item.description: Item name/id to place; null or omitted clears the slot

nbt.description: Raw prismarine-nbt tag to attach to the item

name: creative_set_inventory_slot
